name: hcoll_reduce_lane-safe-COMMIT
purpose: HBM COLL reduce lane (x16) for the SAFE q2/q3 COLL quadrant parents (lp_ars); gate first, route after checklist review

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_coll_reduce_lane u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hgi_coll_reduce_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hgi_coll_safe_leaves.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/p2p/ot_hgi_coll_pring_static.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hcoll_reduce_lane/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hcoll_reduce_lane/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hcoll_reduce_lane --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_coll_reduce_lane  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: COLLQ3 10-19 NEW hard leaf: the q2/q3 COLL parents' soft ot_hgi_coll_reduce_static (21.2k soft flops on the sw root) split exactly into the soft control ot_hgi_coll_reduce_static_ctl + 16 of this lane (tb_hgi_coll_reduce_split_eq); state 512 b per lane (< 2 kb: flops)
